description: This file contains implementation code for a search transformation module specifically for the Linkup API within a larger search framework. It defines data structures, configuration, validation, URL construction, request transformation, and response parsing related to querying the Linkup search API.

classes.name: LinkupSearchConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for interacting with the Linkup search API, including environment validation, URL construction, request transformation, and response parsing.

methods.name: str ui_friendly_name()
methods.description: Returns the user-friendly name of the search provider, 'Linkup'.

methods.name: Dict validate_environment( self, headers: Dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Validates environment variables and prepares request headers, primarily adding the API key and content type.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], optional_params: dict, data: Optional[Union[Dict, List[Dict]]] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Constructs the complete API endpoint URL for the search request, appending '/search' if necessary.

methods.name: Dict transform_search_request( self, query: Union[str, List[str]], optional_params: dict, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Transforms the input query and parameters into the specific format expected by the Linkup API request.

methods.name: SearchResponse transform_search_response( self, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Transforms the raw HTTP response from Linkup API into the standardized SearchResponse format used within the application.
